title: Facile fabrication of thermal-control ionic liquid compound based on undecatungstophosphoindic polyoxometalate with fast ionic conductivity
abstract: Thermal-depended conductive properties of the ternary-POM-based layer-structure ionic liquid [TOAMe]                     4                     [In(H                     2                     O)PW                     11                     O                     39                     ] was investigated. It shows fast ionic conductivity as high as 2.2 × 10                     −3                     S cm                     −1                     at 90 °C with the conductive activation energy of 30.19 kJ mol                     −1                     , which is related to its state, obviously increasing during the reversible phase transformation from a quasi-solid-state gel phase to an isotropic sol phase.
